Overview & role

cupertino_native_better (internally still package:cupertino_native_better/...) is the iOS native tier of the host app. On iOS 26+ and macOS 26+ it renders Apple's real Liquid Glass through Swift/UIKit (iOS) and AppKit (macOS) UiKitView/AppKitView platform views; on older Apple OSes it falls back to Cupertino; on Android/web it falls back to Material. It is the concrete implementation beneath appbox_kit's Kit* ports — the host almost never imports cupertino_native_better directly; appbox_kit does, and re-exports nothing.

The package ships three layers fused into one path dep: a federated Flutter plugin (Dart platform interface + method channel + Swift/SPM native), a Dart widget library of CN* widgets that own the build-time platform branch, and an iOS-26-only native tab-bar takeover (CNTabBarNative) that bypasses the widget tree and presents a real UITabBarController.

cupertino_native_better is the iOS native tier under appbox_kit's Kit* ports.

Glossary

TermMeaning
CN*Naming prefix for every public Dart widget/class in this package: CNButton, CNIcon, CNTabBar, CNSlider, CNSwitch, CNPopupMenuButton, CNSegmentedControl, CNGlassButtonGroup, CNBottomSheet, CNFloatingIsland, CNSearchBar, CNToast, CNGlassCard, CNSplitButton, etc.
Liquid GlassApple's design language introduced in iOS 26 / macOS 26 — translucent, refractive surfaces rendered natively by UIKit/AppKit. This package surfaces it via UiKitView/AppKitView platform views, not Dart paint.
UiKitView / AppKitViewFlutter platform-view embedders. iOS 26+ CN widgets become a UiKitView backed by a Swift factory; macOS 26+ by an AppKitView + NSView factory. Older OSes use a pure Dart Cupertino widget instead — same Dart API.
CNTabBarRouteObserverA NavigatorObserver exported from components/tab_bar.dart. Must be registered on the root navigator so CN widgets learn when sheets/modals/popups cover them and hide/clip their platform views to stop Liquid Glass halos bleeding through.
PlatformVersionDart-side version detector (utils/version_detector.dart) that parses Platform.operatingSystemVersion — NOT a method channel — so release builds return correct iOS/macOS versions. Auto-initializes on first access.
PlatformViewGuardDebug-only 500 ms gate that delays platform-view creation until the engine has purged stale registrations after a hot restart. No-op in release mode.
ModalHideMixinMixin used by CNButton/CNSlider/CNSwitch/etc. that listens to CNTabBarRouteObserver and self-destroys its platform view while a sheet/popup is above it.
CNTabBarNativeiOS-26-only native tab-bar TAKEOVER (a real UITabBarController). NOT a Flutter Widget — invoked via static CNTabBarNative.enable(...). Drives its own Flutter content per tab.
CupertinoNativeBetterTop-level facade class for low-level platform interactions. Most callers never touch it; use the CN* widgets directly.

Architecture

The package is a federated Flutter plugin plus a Dart widget library. Each widget does a build-time branch:

  • iOS 26+ / macOS 26+ → embed a UiKitView/AppKitView whose native side is built by a Swift *Factory (registered by CupertinoNativePlugin) and rendered by SwiftUI/UIKit/AppKit.
  • Older Apple (iOS < 26, macOS < 26) → emit the equivalent Cupertino widget.
  • Android / web → emit the Material equivalent.

Native code is shipped via Swift Package Manager (ios/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift, macos/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift), with two .podspec files per platform as a CocoaPods fallback. The iOS SPM target depends on SVGKit ~> 3.0 for SVG image rendering. Per-instance method channels (CupertinoNativeXxx_$id, CNGlassCard_$id, CNSearchBar_$id, etc.) wire Dart state to each platform view; the takeover tab bar has its own cn_native_tab_bar channel; a legacy facade channel exposes getPlatformVersion for debugging.

Public API reference

Every public symbol exported by lib/cupertino_native_better.dart, grouped. The barrel exports platform interface + method channel, all components (with two show filters for bottom_sheet), all styles, and the three utilities.

Buttons & groups

Buttons are StatefulWidget wrappers around a Swift factory. CNButtonConfig carries the style; style: CNButtonStyle.glass opts into Liquid Glass. CNGlassButtonGroup unions multiple buttons under one glass effect.

lib/components/button.dart

enum CNButtonStyle { glass, floating, plain, prominent, filled, borderless }

class CNButtonConfig {
  const CNButtonConfig({
    this.style = CNButtonStyle.glass,
    this.glassEffect,
    this.padding,
    this.cornerRadius,
  });
  final CNButtonStyle style;
  final CNGlassEffect? glassEffect;
  final EdgeInsets? padding;
  final double? cornerRadius;
}

class CNButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const CNButton({
    super.key,
    required this.onPressed,
    required this.child,
    this.config = const CNButtonConfig(),
  });
  const CNButton.icon({
    super.key,
    required this.onPressed,
    required this.child,
    this.config = const CNButtonConfig(style: CNButtonStyle.glass),
  });
  final VoidCallback? onPressed;
  final Widget child;
  final CNButtonConfig config;
}
  • Styles L1: glass = Liquid Glass (iOS 26+/macOS 26+); other styles map to UIButton.Configuration variants; Cupertino/Material on older OSes.
  • Config L13-16: Glass effect, padding, corner radius travel with the button into the Swift factory.
  • Constructor L21-23: Same const signature across iOS/macOS/other; the platform branch happens in State.build.

lib/components/glass_button_group.dart

class CNGlassButtonGroup extends StatefulWidget {
  const CNGlassButtonGroup({
    super.key,
    required this.children,
    this.glassEffect,
    this.axis = Axis.horizontal,
  });
  final List<Widget> children;
  final CNGlassEffect? glassEffect;
  final Axis axis;
}
  • Unioned glass L6-7: Children share one Liquid Glass effect — the visual union, not N independent buttons.

lib/components/split_button.dart

class CNSplitButton extends StatelessWidget {
  const CNSplitButton({
    super.key,
    required this.primary,
    this.menuItems = const [],
    this.onMenuItemSelected,
  });
  final Widget primary;
  final List<CNButtonDataPopupItem> menuItems;
  final void Function(int)? onMenuItemSelected;
}
  • Stateless L1: Split button has no controller state; it forwards to CNPopupMenuButton for the menu half.

Tab bar & takeover

Two distinct surfaces share the CNTab name. CNTabBar is a normal StatefulWidget rendered as a UiKitView (iOS 26+) or CupertinoTabBar (older). CNTabBarNative is a class with only static methods — it presents a real UITabBarController that takes over the screen; it is iOS-26-only and is NOT a Flutter Widget.

lib/components/tab_bar.dart

class CNTabBarItem {
  const CNTabBarItem({
    required this.sfSymbol,
    required this.title,
    this.badge,
    this.onTap,
  });
  final CNSymbol sfSymbol;
  final String title;
  final int? badge;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
}

class CNTabBar extends StatefulWidget {
  const CNTabBar({
    super.key,
    required this.items,
    this.selectedIndex = 0,
    this.onTabSelected,
    this.searchItem,
    this.appearance,
  });
  final List<CNTabBarItem> items;
  final int selectedIndex;
  final void Function(int)? onTabSelected;
  final CNTabBarSearchItem? searchItem;
  final dynamic appearance;
}

class CNTabBarRouteObserver extends NavigatorObserver {
  static ValueListenable<int> get modalDepth => _modalDepth;
  static ValueListenable<int> get anyModalDepth => _anyModalDepth;
  static ValueListenable<Rect?> get topModalRect => _topModalRect;
  static void markAnyModalActive();
  static void markAnyModalInactive();
  static void publishTopModalRect(Rect? rect);
}
  • Widget tab bar L11-19: CNTabBar is the embedded (in-tree) Liquid Glass tab bar — drives onTabSelected from Dart.
  • Route observer L21-32: Register on root navigator (MaterialApp/CupertinoApp/GoRouter.observers). Drives modal-hide + halo clipping for every CN widget.
  • Manual bump L26-27: For non-route overlays (Scaffold.showBottomSheet) call markAnyModalActive/Inactive so the tab bar still hides — the observer can't see those.

lib/components/native_tab_bar.dart

enum CNTabMinimizeBehavior { never, onScrollDown, onScrollUp }

class CNTabAccessory {
  const CNTabAccessory({
    required this.text,
    required this.sfSymbol,
    this.onTap,
  });
  final String text;
  final CNSymbol sfSymbol;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
}

class CNTabBarNative {
  static const MethodChannel _channel = MethodChannel('cn_native_tab_bar');
  static bool get isEnabled;
  static Future<void> enable({
    required List<CNTab> tabs,
    CNTabMinimizeBehavior minimizeBehavior = CNTabMinimizeBehavior.onScrollDown,
    CNTabAccessory? bottomAccessory,
    void Function(int index)? onTabSelected,
  });
  static Future<void> disable();
}

class CNTab {
  const CNTab({
    required this.title,
    required this.sfSymbol,
    this.nativeList,
    this.flutterContent,
    this.isSearchTab = false,
  });
  final String title;
  final CNSymbol sfSymbol;
  final CNNativeList? nativeList;
  final Widget? flutterContent;
  final bool isSearchTab;
}
  • NOT a Widget L11-12: CNTabBarNative has no const constructor, no build(); it is a static API over a UITabBarController. iOS 26+ only — no-op elsewhere.
  • Takeover L13-21: enable() presents a real native tab bar that owns the whole screen; each CNTab hosts either a native list or your Flutter content. Do NOT drive an IndexedStack from onTabSelected — the native bar IS the source of truth for selection.
  • Search tab L26-28: At most one CNTab may set isSearchTab: true. On iOS 26 it renders as the unified search pill; the local patch (#2) fixes the refresh race that previously corrupted its selection state.

Sliders, switch, segmented

Each input ships a controller so the host can set/get value imperatively (and the platform view can call back). All three use ModalHideMixin to self-destroy while a modal route is above them.

lib/components/slider.dart

class CNSliderController extends ChangeNotifier {
  CNSliderController({double value = 0.0});
  double get value;
  set value(double v);
}

class CNSlider extends StatefulWidget {
  const CNSlider({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    this.min = 0.0,
    this.max = 1.0,
    this.onChanged,
    this.onChangeStart,
    this.onChangeEnd,
  });
  final CNSliderController controller;
  final double min;
  final double max;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChanged;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChangeStart;
  final ValueChanged<double>? onChangeEnd;
}

Sheets, popups, search, toast

Overlays depend on CNTabBarRouteObserver being registered on the root navigator. CNBottomSheet publishes a geometry probe (topModalRect) so only CN widgets whose rect actually intersects the sheet get hidden — the rest stay alive.

lib/components/bottom_sheet.dart

class CNBottomSheet {
  static Future<T?> show<T>({...});
  static Future<T?> showCupertino<T>({...});
}

class CNSheetGeometryProbe extends StatefulWidget {
  const CNSheetGeometryProbe({super.key, required this.child});
  final Widget child;
}
  • show/showCupertino L1-4: Both attach a CNSheetGeometryProbe that publishes topModalRect; raw showModalBottomSheet leaves the probe null and ModalHideMixin falls back to 'destroy everything' (still bleed-free).

class CNPopupMenuItem extends CNPopupMenuEntry {

    this.child,
  });
  final List<CNPopupMenuEntry> Function(BuildContext) itemBuilder;
  final ValueChanged<dynamic>? onSelected;
  final Widget? child;
}

Icon, Liquid Glass container, glass card

CNIcon is the SF Symbols bridge. LiquidGlassContainer wraps any child in a real Liquid Glass background via UiKitView — do NOT put it inside a ListView.builder/GridView (platform-view creation cost per cell). CNGlassCard (experimental) is the styled card surface on top of the container.

lib/components/icon.dart

class CNIcon extends StatefulWidget {
  const CNIcon({
    super.key,
    this.sfSymbol,
    this.iconData,
    this.imageAsset,
    this.size = 24,
    this.color,
    this.renderingMode,
  });
  final CNSymbol? sfSymbol;
  final IconData? iconData;
  final CNImageAsset? imageAsset;
  final double size;
  final Color? color;
  final CNSymbolRenderingMode? renderingMode;
}
  • Three icon types L6-8: Exactly one of sfSymbol (iOS/macOS native), iconData (Flutter IconData), or imageAsset (raster/SVG via SVGKit on iOS).

lib/components/liquid_glass_container.dart

class LiquidGlassContainer extends StatefulWidget {
  const LiquidGlassContainer({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.glassEffect,
    this.shape = CNGlassEffectShape.rectangle,
  });
  final Widget child;
  final CNGlassEffect? glassEffect;
  final CNGlassEffectShape shape;
}
  • UiKitView-backed L1-2: iOS 26+ embeds a UiKitView; older OSes render a ClipRRect+SizedBox fallback. Avoid inside virtualizing lists — see Gotchas.

lib/utils/version_detector.dart

class PlatformVersion {
  // Auto-initializes on first access.
  static Future<void> ensureInitialized();
  static int? get iosMajor;
  static int? get iosMinor;
  static int? get macosMajor;
  static int? get macosMinor;

}
  • Dart parsing L1-3: Parses Platform.operatingSystemVersion (not a method channel) so release builds return correct versions. Used at widget build time to pick UiKitView vs Cupertino.

lib/components/tab_bar.dart (lines 1547+)

class CNTabBarRouteObserver extends NavigatorObserver {
  static ValueListenable<int> get modalDepth;     // narrow: only *Sheet
  static ValueListenable<int> get anyModalDepth;  // broad: any modal
  static ValueListenable<Rect?> get topModalRect; // sheet probe
  static void markAnyModalActive();               // for non-route overlays
  static void markAnyModalInactive();
  static void publishTopModalRect(Rect? rect);    // called by CNBottomSheet probe
  @override void didPush(Route route, Route? previousRoute);
  @override void didPop(Route route, Route? previousRoute);
}
  • Three notifiers L2-4: modalDepth drives CNTabBar auto-hide; anyModalDepth drives CNButton/CNSlider/CNSwitch halo clipping; topModalRect enables position-aware hide.
  • Manual bump L5-6: Pair markAnyModalActive/Inactive for showBottomSheet-style overlays the observer can't see.

Usage playbook

host_app/lib/main.dart

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:cupertino_native_better/cupertino_native_better.dart';

void main() => runApp(const MyApp());

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      // REQUIRED: register the route observer on the root navigator.
      navigatorObservers: [CNTabBarRouteObserver()],
      home: const Home(),
    );
  }
}

class Home extends StatefulWidget {
  const Home({super.key});
  @override
  State<Home> createState() => _HomeState();
}

class _HomeState extends State<Home> {
  final _slider = CNSliderController(value: 0.4);
  final _switch = CNSwitchController(value: true);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            CNButton(
              onPressed: () {},
              child: const Text('Push'),
              config: const CNButtonConfig(style: CNButtonStyle.glass),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            CNSlider(controller: _slider, min: 0, max: 100),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            CNSwitch(controller: _switch),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            LiquidGlassContainer(
              child: const Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text('Liquid Glass surface'),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
  • Observer L9: Without CNTabBarRouteObserver on the root navigator, glass halos bleed through sheets and popups.
  • Glass L31: style: CNButtonStyle.glass picks Liquid Glass on iOS 26+; falls back to Cupertino on older Apple, Material elsewhere.

Wiring

Hosts almost never declare this package as a direct dep.

It is a path: dependency of appbox_kit (path: ../cupertino_native_better); appbox_kit is the only intended consumer. Importing cupertino_native_better directly from a host app is fine for one-off native surfaces, but the Kit* ports are the supported surface. iOS deployment target: 15.0 (set in ios/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift). macOS deployment target: 11.0. Swift tools version 5.9. Native code is consumed via Swift Package Manager (with .podspec fallbacks).

The two local patches held in this vendored fork:

pubspec.yaml (patch #1)

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  # LOCAL PATCH: upstream uses CupertinoIcons.* glyphs (toast.dart) without
  # depending on the cupertino_icons font package, so every toast icon
  # renders as a "?" tofu box in apps that don't happen to pull it in
  # themselves (observed on the iOS 26.5 sim). Declaring it here bundles
  # the icon font.
  cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8
  plugin_platform_interface: ^2.0.2
  • Patch #1 L8: Revert when upstream accepts the dependency; this is a no-op patch for apps that already pull cupertino_icons, and additive for everyone else.

appbox_kit/pubspec.yaml (records patch #2)

  # Vendored at ../cupertino_native_better: upstream 1.5.2 + local fix to the
  # iOS tab-bar platform view (refresh no longer clobbers native selection /
  # setSelectedIndex race — the "Search tab mixed state" ticket). Path dep
  # so the patch survives `pub cache repair`; drop back to hosted once
  # upstreamed.
  cupertino_native_better:
    path: ../cupertino_native_better
  • Path dep L5-6: Path dep (not hosted) so the local fix survives pub cache repair. Patch #2 lives in the Swift tab-bar factory on the iOS side and pairs with CNTabBarRouteObserver/CNTabBar logic in components/tab_bar.dart.
CNTabBarRouteObserver() must be on the root navigator.

On MaterialApp use navigatorObservers:; on CupertinoApp likewise; on GoRouter use observers: on the router config. Without it, anyModalDepth never advances and Liquid Glass halos bleed through sheets/modals/popups. For non-route overlays (Scaffold.showBottomSheet, persistent bottom sheets) you must also call CNTabBarRouteObserver.markAnyModalActive() on open and markAnyModalInactive() on close — the observer can only see route-based modals.

Features appendix

  • Real Liquid Glass on iOS 26+ via UiKitView (Swift factories + SwiftUI/UIKit)
  • Real Liquid Glass on macOS 26+ via AppKitView (NSView factories)
  • Cupertino fallback on older Apple OSes (same Dart API)
  • Material fallback on Android / web
  • SF Symbols via CNIcon + CNSymbol (hierarchical / palette / multicolor rendering)
  • SVG image rendering on iOS via SVGKit ~>3.0 (binary weight — see Gotchas)
  • Imperative controllers: CNSliderController, CNSwitchController, CNRangeSliderController, CNSearchBarController, CNTabBarSearchController, CNFloatingIslandController
  • Glass unioning via CNGlassButtonGroup (multiple buttons share one effect)
  • Dark-mode tint sync via ThemeHelper (Swift side reads Flutter theme channel)
  • Reliable PlatformVersion via Platform.operatingSystemVersion parsing (no method channel) — fixes release-build misdetection
  • PlatformViewGuard delays platform-view creation 500 ms in debug to skip the hot-restart recycle race; no-op in release
  • CNTabBarRouteObserver drives modal-hide + halo clipping for all CN widgets (modalDepth / anyModalDepth / topModalRect notifiers)
  • Position-aware hide via CNSheetGeometryProbe — only CN widgets whose rect intersects the sheet get destroyed
  • CNTabBarNative: iOS-26-only native UITabBarController takeover with search, minimize-on-scroll, bottom accessory, native lists

Embedded tab bar

example/embedded_tab_bar.dart

CNTabBar(
  selectedIndex: _index,
  onTabSelected: (i) => setState(() => _index = i),
  items: const [
    CNTabBarItem(sfSymbol: CNSymbol('house.fill'), title: 'Home'),
    CNTabBarItem(sfSymbol: CNSymbol('magnifyingglass'), title: 'Search'),
    CNTabBarItem(sfSymbol: CNSymbol('person.fill'), title: 'Profile', badge: 3),

)

Native takeover

example/native_takeover.dart

Future<void> presentTakeover() async {
  await CNTabBarNative.enable(
    tabs: [
      CNTab(
        title: 'Feed',
        sfSymbol: CNSymbol('list.bullet'),
        nativeList: const CNNativeList(items: feedItems),
      ),
      CNTab(title: 'Profile', sfSymbol: CNSymbol('person.fill')),
      CNTab(title: 'Search', isSearchTab: true),
    ],
    minimizeBehavior: CNTabMinimizeBehavior.onScrollDown,
    bottomAccessory: CNTabAccessory(
      text: 'Now playing',
      sfSymbol: CNSymbol('music.note'),
    ),
    onTabSelected: (i) => debugPrint('tab $i'),
  );
}

Modal sheet

example/sheet.dart

Future<void> openSheet(BuildContext context) {
  return CNBottomSheet.show(
    context: context,
    builder: (ctx) => const Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Text('Sheet content'),
    ),
  );
}

Non-route overlay

example/persistent_bottom_sheet.dart

void openPersistentSheet(BuildContext context) {
  final controller = Scaffold.of(context).showBottomSheet(
    (ctx) => const SizedBox(height: 200, child: Center(child: Text('Persistent'))),
  );
  CNTabBarRouteObserver.markAnyModalActive();
  controller.closed.whenComplete(
    CNTabBarRouteObserver.markAnyModalInactive,
  );
}

Gotchas

Two local patches — revert when upstreamed.

Patch #1 (cupertino_icons: ^1.0.8 in this package's pubspec.yaml) fixes "?" tofu toast icons. Patch #2 (in the Swift tab-bar factory + components/tab_bar.dart) fixes the iOS tab-bar platform-view refresh race that corrupted the search tab's selection ("Search tab mixed state"). Both are recorded in code comments; the path dep on appbox_kit ensures they survive pub cache repair. When upstream ships both, drop back to hosted.

SVGKit adds binary weight on iOS.

The iOS SPM target depends on SVGKit ~> 3.0. If you don't use SVG image assets via CNImageAsset, you still pay the binary cost — this is upstream behavior, not a local choice.

CNTabBarNative is iOS-26-only AND not a Flutter Widget.

It's a class with static enable()/disable() methods that present a real UITabBarController. Two consequences: (a) on iOS < 26 / macOS / Android / web, enable() is a no-op — do not gate it from Dart; (b) do NOT drive an IndexedStack from onTabSelected. The native bar IS the source of truth for selection; mirroring it into a Flutter IndexedStack creates a double-source-of-truth race (the same class of bug patch #2 fixed).

LiquidGlassContainer is a UiKitView.

Don't put it (or CNButton, CNSlider, CNSwitch, etc.) inside a ListView.builder / GridView / any virtualizing list. Each cell creates a platform view, which is expensive to mount and recycle. Use the Dart fallback (Cupertino/Material) for cells, or hoist the glass surface above the list.

macOS support is real, not just a topics claim.

pubspec.yaml declares macos: pluginClass: CupertinoNativePlugin and the macOS SPM package at macos/cupertino_native_better/Package.swift ships a full Swift target (AppKit NSView factories for button, slider, switch, segmented control, popup menu, tab bar, glass container). The old macos/Classes/ Cocoapods convention is replaced by SPM sources under macos/cupertino_native_better/Sources/. The macOS deployment target is 11.0; Liquid Glass surfaces light up on macOS 26+.

Decisions / ADRs

No formal ADRs in this package. Two upstream-pending decisions are documented in code comments as the local-patch rationale (patches #1 and #2). When upstreaming, capture the iOS-26-only / non-Widget nature of CNTabBarNative and the CNTabBarRouteObserver-must-be-on-root-navigator contract in upstream docs.
